title: Smart Infrastructure Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Sensor networks, infrastructure models, maintenance data, and resilience analysis. The Smart Infrastructure Database documents infrastructure that reports on itself: sensor networks on bridges, grids, water systems, and buildings; the models that interpret the data; maintenance records and predictions; and resilience analyses for failures and disasters. A bridge that tells you it is cracking is maintainable; one that does not is a surprise — each record covers sensing, interpretation, maintenance, and the resilience case.

title: Smart Infrastructure Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Sensing: structural (strain, acceleration, displacement, tilt), environmental (temperature, humidity, corrosion), utility (flow, pressure, power quality). Networks: wired (reliable, expensive), wireless (WSN, LoRa for long range/low power), power (mains, solar+battery, energy harvesting). Models: FE for structures (modal properties from vibration data), hydraulic for water networks (pressure/flow), power-flow for grids. Maintenance: condition-based (act on measurements) vs time-based; degradation curves; remaining-useful-life estimation. Resilience: hazard scenarios (earthquake, flood, cyber), cascading failures (one system's failure loads another), recovery time objectives. Alerts: thresholds with hysteresis; false-positive management; escalation procedures. Data: time-series storage, anomaly detection baselines.

demo.title: Execution: A* pathfinding on a grid
demo.code: const grid=[[0,0,0,1],[0,1,0,0],[0,0,0,0]];const W=4,H=3;function h(a,b){return Math.abs(a[0]-b[0])+Math.abs(a[1]-b[1]);}function astar(s,g){const open=[{p:s,f:h(s,g),c:0}],came={},cost={[s]:0};while(open.length){open.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);const cur=open.shift();if(cur.p[0]===g[0]&&cur.p[1]===g[1]){const path=[g];let k=g+'';while(came[k]){path.unshift(came[k]);k=came[k]+'';}return path;}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[cur.p[0]+dx,cur.p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=H||n[1]>=W||grid[n[0]][n[1]])continue;const nc=cur.c+1;if(cost[n+'']===undefined||nc<cost[n+'']){cost[n+'']=nc;came[n+'']=cur.p;open.push({p:n,f:nc+h(n,g),c:nc});}}}}const path=astar([0,0],[2,3]);J({steps:path.length-1});assert(path.length-1===5,'astar');

title: Smart Infrastructure Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: design test (risks map to sensors); tuning test (thresholds balance detection vs false positives); scenario test (cascades traced completely); determinism test. Limitations: demos use sample data; real deployments need site surveys; model calibration needs measurements. Every design states its assumptions and calibration schedule.

demo.title: Execution: Hohmann transfer delta-v
demo.code: const mu=398600;function circ(r){return Math.sqrt(mu/r);}const r1=6678,r2=42164;const a=(r1+r2)/2;const dv1=Math.abs(Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r1-1/a))-circ(r1));const dv2=Math.abs(circ(r2)-Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r2-1/a)));J({dv1:+dv1.toFixed(2),dv2:+dv2.toFixed(2),total:+(dv1+dv2).toFixed(2)});assert(dv1+dv2>3.8&&dv1+dv2<4.0,'hohmann');
